findings.summary: Dark-theme download call-to-action text fails minimum contrast.
findings.fix: Set the dark-theme banner CTA text to a light foreground or give it a background that provides at least 4.5:1 for its 18px normal-weight text.

findings.fix: Use theme-aware badge-panel background and link colors, or retain a sufficiently dark foreground on the #cccccc panel in both themes.
